M/S Ravenbhel Health Care Private ... vs Union Territory 
Through Food Safety ... on 21 February, 2024 
Author: Rajnesh Oswal
Bench: Rajnesh Oswal
 164
 Supp List
 High Court Of Jammu &Kashmir And Ladakh
 At Srinagar
 CrlM No. 172/2024
 In Crm (M) No. 65/2024
 CrlM No. 173/2024
M/s Ravenbhel Health Care Private Limited and Ors.
 ..... Petitioner (s)
 Through: Mr. F A Wani, Adv.
 V/s
Union Territory through Food Safety Officer Block Bandipora
 ..... Respondent(s)
 Through:
Coram:
 Hon'ble Mr. Justice Rajnesh Oswal, Judge.
 Order
21.02.2024
1.  After arguing for a while, learned counsel for the petitioner seeks withdrawal of the petition with liberty to file fresh one. His statement is taken on record. The petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for. 
(Rajnesh Oswal) Judge SRINAGAR 21.02.2024 Aasif M/S Ravenbhel Health Care Private ... vs Union Territory Through Food Safety ... on 21 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106490302/
